title: NoRealms
description: A lightweight client-side Minecraft mod that simply removes the Realms button from the main menu for a cleaner and more customizable UI experience.
body:
Remove Realms Button

A lightweight client-side Minecraft mod that simply removes the Realms button from the main menu for a cleaner and more customizable UI experience.

Designed to be minimal, fast, and highly compatible with large modpacks, this mod only changes the main menu interface and does not modify gameplay, networking, or performance.

Features
Removes the Realms button from the title screen
Clean and simple implementation
Client-side only
Extremely lightweight
Safe for modpacks
No configuration required
Compatible with most UI and performance mods
